subject: SIG + SOC2 onboarding: Vendr portal access & ownership for Odessa Systems
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@odessasys.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: portal-team@vendr.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Odessa security onboarding: portal access for SIG/QNA

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this — Odessa Systems is ready to onboard our security profile to Vendr so you can run the SIG/QnA and collect evidence. Our security team (security@odessasys.com) will own uploads but we'd like a single Redwood point of contact for evidence questions and to triage any missing artifacts.

Quick context: we recently completed a scoped SOC 2 Type II audit (controls mapped to infrastructure and product release) and we have a short SOC2-summary PDF and a CSV inventory of controls. For Vendr we can:
- Accept a portal invite and upload bundled artifacts (PDFs, scopes)
- Provide API access for manifesting artifacts if you prefer automated pushes

Could you confirm:
1) Primary Redwood owner for the onboarding?
2) Any specific evidence format constraints (preferred filenames, CAIQ mapping)?
3) Target completion window — Odessa would like the SIG/QnA verified within 10 business days if possible.

I'll send the Vendr invite link and the SOC2 summary in a follow-up (attaching now).

Thanks,
Samir
Security Operations
Odessa Systems

Attachments: ODESSSA_SOC2-summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@odessasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Odessa security onboarding: portal access for SIG/QNA

Hi Samir — welcome, and thanks for the summary.

I'm the single point on the Redwood side for this intake — I'll coordinate uploads with our security intake lead Marissa and our portal ops (Ben) for any manifest/API steps. To answer your questions briefly:
1) Primary Redwood owner: Grace O'Connor (me) — I'll escalate if anything needs leadership attention.
2) Preferred artifact approach: Vendr accepts archives and a CSV manifest; we prefer: filename prefix ODESSA_[type]_[YYYYMMDD].pdf and a short manifest CSV with fields (filename, control_ref, control_description). I'll attach a small starter template so teams can drop into your upload bundle.
3) Target: 10 business days is reasonable — we'll aim for internal triage in 48 business hours.

Next steps: Marissa — can you review the SOC2 summary and confirm which sections we'll need to request full artifact copies for (e.g., syslog samples, SOC2 control narratives)? Ben — once Odessa accepts the Vendr invite, can you confirm the portal permissions we should request (Reader + Evidence Uploader)?

Samir — please share the Vendr invite link and any contact at Vendr that will accept our onboarding questions.

Thanks — Grace

Attachment: initial-inventory-template.csv (simple manifest template)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@odessasys.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Odessa security onboarding: portal access for SIG/QNA

Grace / Ben — quick intake notes after reviewing the SOC2 summary Samir sent.

Observations:
- The summary indicates coverage for infrastructure change controls and access management but is light on evidence pointers for logging/retention windows. We'll need:
  * Mapping of control IDs to evidence artifacts (config exports, policy PDFs, sample syslogs)
  * Clarify log retention period (S3 bucket location and TTL) and whether logs are in US or EU region (affects export requests).

Requests for Odessa:
1) Please upload the full SOC2 report (redacted where necessary) or provide SOC2 cover letter + control narratives.
2) For controls that reference logging, provide one week of sample logs (sample_files.log.gz) and the retention policy doc.
3) If you have a CAIQ mapping already, upload that; otherwise we'll map SIG->CAIQ on our side and send a mapping sheet.

I've attached the evidence request workbook I use during portal onboards — it contains the checklist we'll track in our CS portal and the fields we need from Odessa to close each SIG question. Ben, when Odessa accepts the Vendr invite, let's set up the uploader role and a shared folder naming convention: /Odessa/2027-08-Vendr.

Samir — is the Odessa team OK with redacting PII in samples? If yes, we'll accept redacted logs. If not, we need to coordinate an egress-safe transfer mechanism (SFTP with temp creds or secured Drive link).

Marissa
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-evidence-requests.xlsx (onboarding checklist and column definitions)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@odessasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: portal-team@vendr.com, security@odessasys.com
Date: 2027-08-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Odessa security onboarding: portal access for SIG/QNA

Thanks Marissa — confirmed. We can do redacted logs and will populate the manifest per your template.

Vendr invite: https://app.vendr.com/invite/abcd1234 (also attached as an HTML invite stub). The invite was sent to portal-ops@redwood.com — please accept with the uploader account you prefer; I can re-send to specific emails if easier.

Attachments included:
- odessa_vendr_invite.html (portal invite stub)
- ODESSSA_SOC2-summary.pdf (original summary)

We expect to upload: full SOC2 cover letter (redacted), CAIQ CSV (if we can export it from our portal), and a sample syslog bundle (redacted). We'll aim to have the initial uploads within 3 business days.

If Redwood prefers an automated manifest push instead of manual uploads, let Ben know and we can provide API keys scoped to a manifest endpoint.

— Samir
Security Ops, Odessa Systems
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@odessasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Odessa security onboarding: portal access for SIG/QNA

Samir — perfect, thanks for the invite and the PDFs. We accepted the Vendr link and created /Odessa/2027-08-Vendr as the shared upload folder; Ben set the uploader role to the accounts Marissa listed (uploader + reader).

Mutual action plan (short):
- Day 0 (today): Vendr invite accepted — confirm uploader access (done).
- Day 1–3: Odessa uploads: full SOC2 redacted, CAIQ export or CAIQ mapping, sample syslog bundle (redacted).
- Day 4–7: Redwood intake: Marissa will map control IDs to SIG/QnA entries and flag missing artifacts.
- Day 8–10: Closure window — final clarifications and sign-off on SIG map.

Marissa — I'll create the HubSpot record HS-742159 and link to the Vendr invite and the evidence workbook. Jonas — please add a portal-health check to make sure artifact filenames pass our ingest parser (regex check: ^ODESSA_).

Samir — thank you — we will reach out with any gaps by EOD Monday.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Grace O'Connor
Redwood Inference
